NPhysicalShells.native_gram_physical_shell_limit.{u_1, u_2, u_3} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K] {ι : Type u_2}
  {J : Type u_3} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu]
  [SFinite mu] (chi : ι → MasulloGRH.UnitaryHeckeCharacter K) (z : ι → ℂ) (a s alpha : ℝ) (m : ι → ℕ)
  (hg :
    ∀ (i : ι),
      MemLp (Masullo.GenuineNormalizedMellinJet.genuineNormalizedMellinJet K (chi i) (z i) a s alpha (m i)) 2 mu)
  (hclosed : Masullo.GramDualPairingIntegrable.JetClosed K chi z m) (h : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ)
  (hh : Continuous h) (hc : HasCompactSupport h) (p : J → MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℝ)
  (hp : ReviewM.PositivePartition p) :
  have d := fun x =>
    Masullo.TransposeDiagonalIntegrable.finitePAKernel K Finset.univ mu chi z a m h
      (Masullo.ActualGram.actualGramDual K mu chi z a s alpha m) x x;
  Tendsto
    (fun n =>
      ∑' (j : J),
        ‖∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ↑(p j x) * (NPhysicalShells.physicalBand K n).indicator d x ∂mu -
            ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ↑(p j x) * d x ∂mu‖)
    atTop (𝓝 0)
